name: Rizuhble's Nine Lives Calico
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Return to Shadows unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Split Shot. Ultimate (Return to Shadows) is available from Sprint Boots.

items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Split Shot completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Split Shot completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Split Shot
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Temporary, sold when you buy Ricochet later.

items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-27,200 (levels 13-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Leaping Slash T3, Ava T3, Return to Shadows T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Leaping Slash, impact damage) grows from 53.5 to 70. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Fortitude.

items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Burst Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-59,200 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Gloom Bombs T3.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Burst Fire.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Burst Fire.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you before you can get out.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts catch you as you come out of Ava.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep you off them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Leaping Slash (movement) and Ava (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep stopping your slash and your ult.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Silencer for this, or Hunter's Aura if it's gone.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
